description: Give a COMP a Python extension class: create a Text DAT holding the class (with optional method stubs), wire it into an extension slot, optionally promote it (so members are callable directly on the COMP), and reinitialize. The other half of making a generated network reusable — pair with `add_custom_parameters` (knobs) and `manage_component` (save as .tox).

class_name.description: Extension class name, e.g. 'WidgetExt' (capitalized to a valid identifier; must already be identifier-safe).

comp_path.description: The COMP to give a Python extension class.

methods.description: Optional method-name stubs to add to the class (each takes only `self`).

promote.description: Promote the extension so its members are callable directly on the COMP (op.Method()).

slot.description: Extension slot (1–8) — a COMP can hold several extensions.

name: scaffold_extension
title: Scaffold extension class
